messages:
build-bot: notice: nightly perf run flagged host-ingress p95 regression on staging at 02:10 UTC
Asha: summary: tokenizer p95 spike tied to new kernel-selection rollout. traces show frequent short-lived k-v cache misses coinciding with tokenization stalls.
Rafael: dug into staging flamegraphs: tokenizer threads show heavy `memmove` from proto unpack, and scheduler wakeups around write syscalls. packetizer shows increased `writev` counts with small iovec lengths.
Maya: network traces show many small chunks; HTTP2 WINDOW_UPDATE bursts align with flushes.
Asha: local replay with config reproduced: p95 +65ms, write syscall rate up x2.7.
Rafael: immediate mitigation plan: rollback kernel-selection to previous profile; enable write coalesce patch in packetizer; increase tokenizer pool size by 2x temporarily; bump KV cache per-shard buffer 15%.
Maya: I'll stage coalesce patch. Rafael: I'll open rollback PR. Asha: I'll coordinate staging deploy and perf run.
build-bot: staged rollback + coalesce for perf run at 02:40 UTC
Asha: perf run shows p95 returned to baseline. We'll own follow-ups: create microbench harness for token-burst patterns, instrument KV hot-shard heat metric, add automated canary rollback if writev count >200/s per host.
Rafael: extracting artifacts and will write up the postmortem.
Maya: adding tests for packetizer coalescer behavior with variable kernel outputs.
Asha: thanks team, moving to postmortem doc task. :spiral_note_pad:
